extraction.boxscore.json: Selected game metadata and original homeTeam/awayTeam objects from __NEXT_DATA__.props.pageProps.game

source_notes: Direct liveData CDN endpoints returned HTTP 403; the public NBA game page was accessible and supplied these embedded JSON objects.
The play-by-play source is hanaV3; its schema differs from NBA liveData JSON.
32 actionNumber values are shared by related events, such as a shot and its block. actionId is unique in this snapshot. Preserve source event order.
Team-level events may use a team ID in personId. Empty actionType entries include related block and steal events.

Explicit starter flags are absent from the player objects. The importer reconstructs period-start lineups from events and substitutions and validates player minutes and plus/minus against the box score.
integration_status: Supported by the local import_nba_game management command as dataset nba-2026-27. Import remains an explicit step for each database.
validation_scope: Download integrity checks above cover game identity, basic event completeness, roster IDs, and final-score consistency. The converter additionally validates reconstructed lineups, player minutes, every participating player's plus/minus, and team counting statistics. The import report records the possession conventions.
